negative_result_boundary.interpretation: R1 hard-slot graph rejected; it cannot be rescued by threshold relaxation

phase_trunk_exactness.input: late layer 24 patch tokens spatially mean-pooled to [32,1024] only inside phase trunk
phase_trunk_exactness.descriptor: time-center; concatenate centered sequence and directed residual sequences at stride 1,2,4; L2 normalize
phase_trunk_exactness.claim_boundary: R0 global spatial pooling is confined to the independent phase trunk and never enters object components or graph

object_trunk_exactness.input: layers 6,12,24 patch tokens [3,32,256,1024] projected by pinned R1 channel map to [32,256,144]
object_trunk_exactness.motion_only: first temporal differences; coordinatewise spatial median background removal; fixed SHA-sign 144x16 projection

components.cardinality: 0 if dynamic mass<=1e-6; 1 if mass<=0.01 or participation<=8; else clip(ceil(participation/40),2,6)
components.soft_assignment: 12 fixed-temperature EM iterations over 85% motion cosine cost + 15% normalized internal spatial cost
components.dustbin_or_abstention: 0-component phases are explicit abstentions; no phantom slot is created

tracking.hypotheses: three position weights 0,0.15,0.30; posterior marginalization temperature 0.08
tracking.empty_transitions: 0->K full birth; K->0 full death; 0->0 abstain; transport matrix has exact empty geometry

soft_graph.node_final_features: relative phase, mass, motion energy, shape eigen statistics, birth/death, support entropy, 16D motion residual direction
soft_graph.edge_final_features: relative phase, pair distance/overlap, relative motion/convergence, canonical endpoint mass-energy-degree summaries
soft_graph.edge_creation: all unordered pairs only in phases with >=2 components; no top-k/NMS
soft_graph.validity: at least 4/8 phases have effective cardinality>=1.2 and >=2 components; nonexisting nodes/edges are masked; finite positive observed masses

object_trunk_exactness.comparison: independent unbalanced-OT similarities for node, edge, tracking sets; object score is lexicographic minimum and every component has its own floor

input_controls.shuffle: 8 contiguous 8-frame blocks sorted by SHA256('r1b-target-shuffle:20260823:'+pair_id+':'+block); rotate by3 if identity/reverse

counterfactual_controls.spatial_slot_permutation: within every noninitial phase cyclically permute component centers relative to motion/mass, rebuild OT and graph; preserves the motion-component feature multiset but breaks motion-spatial binding
counterfactual_controls.drop_edge: remove the globally highest half of soft edge mass, retaining at least one edge

independent_null_calibration_bank.valid_phase_policy: minimum 4/8 is a pre-feature 50-percent support feasibility rule; 0/1 phases abstain and do not fabricate slots

admission_formula.pair_phase_pass: target_forward_eval exceeds each reverse/shuffle/source phase score by >=0.005
admission_formula.pair_object_pass: all7 graphs valid AND node/edge/tracking floors AND lexicographic-min eval exceeds each input negative by>=0.02 AND both counterfactual margins pass
admission_formula.all16_control_gate: for both phase and object branches separately, eval exceeds each of reverse/shuffle/source in >=12/16
admission_formula.family_gate: each family requires >=2/3 development and 1/1 locked validation pair passes
admission_formula.global_gate: >=9/12 development and nominal >=3/4 locked validation; family gate makes effective locked requirement 4/4
admission_formula.final: all global, per-control, and every-family gates must pass
